app_info.subtitle: Japan government procurement & bid intelligence
app_info.description: JP Bids helps users search, evaluate, and monitor Japanese public-sector procurement notices (government tenders) published on the official Small and Medium Enterprise Agency KKJ portal. Users can search by keyword, project name, organization, prefecture, category, or date range; prioritize opportunities using AI Bid Radar scoring (pursue/review/skip); attempt structured extraction of qualification requirements and document checklists; and export shortlisted tenders to spreadsheet-compatible CSV or JSON (16 columns). All data is read-only public government information; the app never submits bids, applications, or any data on the user's behalf.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries the public KKJ procurement search API and returns matching notices; it never creates, updates, or deletes anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries an unpredictable, continuously-updated public data set (like a web search) but does not write, publish, or otherwise change any public-facing state; results are returned only to the requesting user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only search with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects of any kind.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Has no side effects on external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists recently published KKJ notices for a 1-30 day announcement window; it only retrieves public data and never modifies anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the public, continuously-updated KKJ notice feed but does not write or publish anything.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only listing with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Has no side effects on external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches full detail for a single bid by signed bid_ref or bid_key and returns official links; it never modifies data and never stores attachments server-side.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns links to official public KKJ pages and attachments (external resources) but does not write, publish, or change any public-facing state itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only detail lookup with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Has no side effects on external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs search or scores user-selected bid_refs in memory using the AI Bid Radar algorithm; no data is created, updated, or deleted anywhere.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the public procurement data set but does not write, broadcast, or publish anything.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only scoring with no delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effects.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Has no side effects on external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Parses metadata and announcement text to attempt structured extraction of eligibility grades, submission deadlines, and document checklists without storing files.
justifications.open_world_justification: May fetch external public document URLs (when explicitly enabled) without changing any external system state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Pure analysis tool with zero data modification or deletion capability.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Declared as false in implementation annotations; operates without write side effects on system state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates 16-column CSV or JSON text for selected bid_refs or search results in memory without storing files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates over current public bid data and user-provided selections without external publishing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Generates in-memory CSV/JSON text; does not overwrite local or remote files.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Declared as false in implementation annotations; operates without write side effects on system state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes public procurement searches and renders an interactive UI workspace on supported MCP Apps hosts, falling back to text and structuredContent on unsupported hosts, with zero backend write actions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the public KKJ dataset and renders cards inside the client's sandboxed canvas; no external state is modified.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sandboxed UI rendering with clipboard copy support; has no delete, overwrite, or persistent storage operations.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Has no side effects on external state.

test_cases.description: Keyword search and detailed view retrieval using signed bid_ref or key.
test_cases.user_prompt: 鹿児島県でIT関連の官公需入札を検索し、その中の1件の詳細と公式URLを確認して。
test_cases.expected_output: search_bids returns matching tender notices (bidRef, key, organization, due date). get_bid_detail restores the selected notice detail and official KKJ announcement link without storing files.

test_cases.description: Recent notices listing by region and category with procuring agency narrowing.
test_cases.user_prompt: 東京都で直近7日間に公告された役務入札を一覧表示し、農林水産省の案件に絞り込んで。
test_cases.expected_output: list_recent_bids returns notices published within days=7. search_bids narrows by organization_name='農林水産省'. Attribution metadata is included in all outputs.

test_cases.description: Prioritize candidate bids using keyword matching and deadline constraints.
test_cases.user_prompt: クラウドや保守に関わる入札を、締切30日以内で追うべき順に評価して。
test_cases.expected_output: Returns rankedBids with score (0-100), priority ('pursue', 'review', or 'skip'), reasons, risks, and nextActions.

test_cases.description: Requirement structured extraction and 16-column shortlist CSV export.
test_cases.user_prompt: 事前検索で選んだ2件の検討案件（有効なbid_ref）について、参加資格・提出期限・必要書類を整理し、検討用CSV形式で出力して。
test_cases.expected_output: extract_bid_requirements organizes metadata requirements and marks unverified items in missingRequirements. export_bid_shortlist returns 16-column CSV text and rankedCount=2.

test_cases.user_prompt: 東京都のIT関連入札をUIワークスペースで最大3件表示して。
test_cases.expected_output: Renders interactive AI Bid Workspace ('ui://jp-bids/search-results.html') on supported hosts (or structured text fallback on text-only hosts) with up to 3 cards.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated private-sector job listings.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: 民間企業のエンジニア求人を探して。
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because private-sector job listings are outside its scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not attempt to submit or apply for a bid on the user's behalf.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: この入札に代わりに応募しておいて。
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app has no write or submission capability and directs the user to apply via official agency channels.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not guess a bid detail without a valid bid_ref/key or prior search context.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: 案件の詳細を教えて（検索やキーの提示なし）。
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Prompts the user to search or provide a valid bid key/bid_ref first rather than calling get_bid_detail with guessed identifiers.
